//: One owner per ecosystem (docs/CONTRIBUTING.md): Dependabot owns GitHub Actions, Docker and Python, Renovate owns JavaScript. The Python manifests under tests/ and research/ are the Dependabot uv entries in .github/dependabot.yml, so ignorePaths keeps Renovate from opening a duplicate, conflicting bump for the same uv.lock. Without this both bots bump the same files and their PRs collide on the lock.

packageRules.//: scripts/check-pins.sh fails any requirement that is not one exact version, so a bump that rewrote package.json, a pyproject.toml or a PEP 723 header into a range would open a PR that leaves `zig build check` red. rangeStrategy=pin keeps the edited manifest at one version; bun.lock and the uv.lock files are what a reviewer reads for the resolved tree. Pre-releases are already excluded (ignoreUnstable defaults to true), so nothing here opts into one.

A release from the hour it was published is not reviewable: this tree ships GPL code, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md records exact versions, and the CI install is keyed on bun.lock. A day is enough for a broken or pulled release to stop being offered; the weekly schedule still lands it the week after.
